decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the reference-rendering aesthetic and extends the visual identity to the support base; no correction is required.
The base finish already requires an exact match to the supplied reference, and the source adds no distinct finish or color rule.
The aesthetic instruction does not change the base's cup-clearance purpose, height, or footprint alignment.
The machine color state already refers to the colors shown in the CAD renderings, and the source establishes no new color or finish value.
The controls already have rendering-based DJ styling; the broad aesthetic statement does not establish a distinct control-specific change.
The spout already must match its supplied rendering as closely as possible, and the source does not alter its appearance, material, or fabrication method.
The general rendering-reference instruction does not modify the placard's established text, position, viewing orientation, or two-sided display.
The source concerns visual reproduction and does not change structural support or operational stability.
Decorative and bowl lighting were already required based on the renderings, and the source adds no new lighting behavior or component constraint.
Aesthetic reproduction of the machine and base does not change liquid-path cleaning or sanitation requirements.
The visual-reference instruction does not change whisk length, depth, foam performance, or splash-control positioning.
The broad aesthetic instruction does not explicitly replace or modify the established cursive E markings or their beige lettering.
